text:
[IRET.7.9.3] **On right-retraction:**
- For each left token the retracted fact blocks, as the index of
  [IRET.7.9.4] records it: decrement its block count. No join test is
  evaluated.
- Each token whose block count drops to 0 propagates downstream (the
  absence holds again). Its wave derives the pairs below it
  ([LERR.1.4.12]).

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract
idris.note: On right-retraction a NOT node uncounts the fact against each left token it joined and propagates downstream the tokens whose count drops to zero.

idris.name: iret_7_9_3__unblock
idris.note: A blocking fact retracted: every left token it joined loses one.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract_ordered
idris.note: The tokens a NOT node releases activate downstream at the timetags they first completed with.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract_consistent
idris.note: A FACT LEAVES ONE ALPHA MEMORY: every chain consistent with the old memories is, after right-retracting its nodes fed by that alpha deepest first, consistent with the new ones. A positive node's extensions by the fact leave the nodes below; a NOT node releases the tokens the fact alone was blocking. The clause's right-retraction, read as 'each left token that joins the retracted fact' since a left token has no facts[k].

idris.name: iret_7_9_3__pass_unblock
idris.note: A NOT node's output after a right fact leaves: what it passed, plus the tokens the fact alone was blocking.

idris.name: iret_7_9_3__pass_unblock_bwd
idris.note: What was passed, or blocked by the fact alone, is passed after it leaves.

idris.name: iret_7_9_3__pass_unblock_fwd
idris.note: What a NOT node passes after a right fact leaves was passed, or was blocked by that fact alone.

idris.name: iret_7_9_3__released_disjoint
idris.note: The released tokens were not passed before.

idris.name: iret_7_9_3__unblock_ok
idris.note: Uncounting a retracted fact against the tokens it joined gives the blockers of the shrunk memory.

idris.name: iret_7_7__right_retract_evolves
idris.note: A NOT node's right-retraction releases matches as unfired: created, not kept.

idris.name: iret_7_9_3__unblock_hit
idris.note: Unblocking takes one from the count of each token hit, given the hits are distinct.

idris.name: iret_7_9_3__unblock_miss
idris.note: Unblocking leaves the count of a token not among those hit.
